data.gender_notes: Suzanna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Sarah', meaning 'lady, noblewoman'. In the biblical story of Susanna and the Elders, Susanna is a beautiful and virtuous wife, who is falsely accused of adultery and is ultimately vindicated. The name Suzanna carries the meaning “Lily, Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Suzanna usually hope their child will grow to embody lily, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
